benches.name: exact_col_tiled
benches.cmd:
B={RUN}/bsrc_m5_0; rm -rf $B && mkdir -p $B && for d in *; do ln -s $PWD/$d $B/$d; done && for d in $(cd physical/ref_tile/dsfd_colt_lane_m5/src && ls -d */ | tr -d /); do rm -f $B/$d; cp -a $PWD/$d $B/$d; done && cp -a physical/ref_tile/dsfd_colt_lane_m5/src/. $B/ && cd $B && { bash tools/s81_ph/colt_bench.sh {RUN}/bench t1 'gold1 gold2 gold3 fault1 fault2 fault3 fault4 fault5'
}
benches.note: [m5rr: run on the 7345266ce snapshot overlay of physical/ref_tile/dsfd_colt_lane_m5/src]
